purpose: Audit two assumptions after the supplied Acemoglu-Pischke full text; not a new market ABM or a novelty claim
unit: Expected probability mass per initial low-score candidate; potential productivity is a separate nonbinary outcome
signal_assumption: Private signal and AI diagnostic are conditionally independent given initial skill; candidate sees both, employer sees neither
matching: Within each private-information/productivity condition, compare diagnostic quality 0.5 with higher quality; never credit private self-information to the AI
interpretation: Finite types and outcome levels, not a continuously distributed skill model; fixed wage and hiring rule, no general equilibrium
seed_policy: No random draws or Monte Carlo; legacy and v1 seeds/results remain untouched
preregistration_status: Internal audit plan, written before this v2 enumeration; not externally preregistered, illustrative and uncalibrated
